page.layout: One page of text, single column, full width. Page number at the head. Catchword "D" at the foot right, with "duno" as the last line of the text. No margin notes.

main_text.p: que commentatam fabulam ! sibi Eccle-fiam. & Verbi Dei explicationem concre-ditam existimant viri minimè turbulen-tam, aliis mandata gubernacula Rerum-publicarum credunt, didicerunt que non esse πολυπραγμονες. Hoc tamen titulo mi-rum quantum ferocire Spanhemii Fratres. protinus

p.i: Africus , & vastos tollunt ad sidera fluctus.

main_text.p: Prodit Tractatus Maresii de Afflicto statu studii Theologici in Belgio , in linguam Bel-gicam vertitur , expunctis tamen illis quæ de suis cum aliis Theologis in Belgio con-troversiis monuerat Maresius , quas & hic D. Spanhemii prudentia intactas voluit. lucem aspicit scriptum belgicum, 't Bewrigt van Coccejaensche en Cartefiaensche Nieuwigheden / admonitio de Novitatibus Coccejanis & Cartefianis ; eristica scripta D. van Rijssen, Disputationes extraordi-nariæ Hulsii , & quod est hujus farinæ am-plius. In his accusantur & traducuntur Coccejus, Wittichius, Academia Lug-duno

page.notes: Black letter words "'t Bewrigt van Coccejaensche en Cartefiaensche Nieuwigheden" are partly illegible in the scan; the transcription of the heading is approximate. The Greek word πολυπραγμονες is approximate. Catchword "duno" and signature "D" are at the foot; the "D" at the centre foot is a signature.
